Hemangioendothelioma is a malig-nant neoplasm arising from vascular endothelium in long bones and most often occurs in the lower extremity.

Hemangiopericytoma is usually a solitary lesion occurring in the soft tissues or the axial skeleton and proximal long bones in middle-aged or older adult males.

Treatment is wide excision.
Angiosarcoma is a soft tissue malig-nancy usually seen in older adult males; chronic vascular stasis is a risk factor.

Treatment is wide excision, or if the tumor is surgically inaccessible, radiation.
